description: Product book (accounts, cards, loans, investments, insurance), one row per product. Typed and checked from workspace.bronze.products, with card expiry, last movement, opening date, number collisions and owner-status conflicts corrected or flagged against Bronze transactions and customers. As-of date 2026-06-18.

load.notes: Single CSV snapshot re-delivered in full. Also reads workspace.bronze.customers (owner country, status, registration) and aggregates workspace.bronze.transactions per product (4.4M rows, the heavy part). Derived columns (effective_status, last_transaction_date_recomputed, customer_status_conflict, ...) are recomputed only for products in the incremental window: run mode=full after new transactions or customers land.

product_id.description: Product identifier (PRD-XXXXXXXXXXXX), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key; referenced by transactions and complaints.

customer_id.description: Owner of the product (customers.customer_id). Every transaction on the product belongs to this customer (100%).

product_type.description: Product type as delivered (Spanish), canonical casing and accents.

product_type_en.description: Canonical English product type (the dictionary uses English; the data is Spanish). Use it in code and joins.

product_number.description: QUARANTINE: account/card/contract number for lookups; NULL when the number is shared with another product of a different customer (6 pairs), so a number lookup never resolves to the wrong customer.

product_number_raw.description: PII. Product number as delivered (16-digit card, 10-digit account, LOAN-, INV- or POL- contract). Display only its last digits.

product_number_collision.description: FLAG: product_number_raw is shared by more than one product in the whole book (12 products); excluded from number lookups.

currency.description: Product currency (ISO 4217). All products of Mexican customers are in USD; about 10% of Colombian and Argentine products are USD too.

currency_usd_for_mexico.description: FLAG: product of a Mexican customer held in USD instead of MXN (all 200,398 of them). Documented assumption: quote Mexican balances in USD, as delivered.

current_balance.description: Current balance in the product currency (outstanding debt for credit products).

credit_limit.description: Credit limit (cards) or granted amount (loans) in the product currency; only for credit products (see credit_limit_null_reason). Unrelated to income or score.

credit_limit_null_reason.description: Why credit_limit is NULL: 'not_applicable' (not a credit product), 'missing' or 'invalid'; NULL when present.

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate in percent (fixed ranges per type, e.g. credit card 18-45, mortgage 6-12, debit card and insurance 0).

interest_rate_null_reason.description: Why interest_rate is NULL: 'missing' (about 10% of every type) or 'invalid'; NULL when present.

days_past_due.description: Days past due for credit products (7 discrete values). Carries no risk signal (AUC 0.504 against credit score); never a label.

days_past_due_null_reason.description: Why days_past_due is NULL: 'not_applicable' (not a credit product), 'missing' or 'invalid'; NULL when present.

opening_date.description: Opening date as delivered. 18.7% of transactions predate it (see effective_opening_date).

effective_opening_date.description: FIX: least(opening_date, date of the first transaction on the product). Use it for 'customer since' and timeline answers.

activity_before_opening.description: FLAG: the product has transactions dated before opening_date.

opened_before_registration.description: FLAG: opening_date is before the owner's registration date (customers.registration_date, read from Bronze).

expiration_date.description: Card expiration date; only for cards (see expiration_date_null_reason).

expiration_date_null_reason.description: Why expiration_date is NULL: 'not_applicable' (not a card), 'missing' or 'invalid'; NULL when present.

opening_branch_id.description: Branch where the product was opened (branches.branch_id; 0 orphans, unlike the customer and agent branch keys).

product_status.description: Product status as delivered (current state, no timestamp). Only Active products have transactions.

effective_status.description: FIX: product_status, except 'Expired' for Active products whose expiration_date is before the as-of date 2026-06-18. Use it for 'is my card active' answers.

customer_status_conflict.description: FLAG: Active product held by a customer whose customer_status is Closed (read from Bronze customers). Precedence rule: Closed or Suspended customers go to a human, whatever the product says. Customer-level rollup: any flagged product.

opening_channel.description: Channel through which the product was opened.

has_linked_app.description: Whether the product is linked to the mobile app.

last_transaction_date.description: Last movement as delivered. Wrong for 99.9% of products (matches the real last transaction for 427 of 305,721); do not use it, see last_transaction_date_recomputed.

last_transaction_date_recomputed.description: FIX: event time of the latest transaction on the product (Bronze transactions, transaction_date); NULL when the product has none.

first_transaction_date.description: Event time of the first transaction on the product; NULL when the product has none.

transaction_count.description: Number of distinct transactions on the product (0 when none).

last_transaction_date_stale.description: FLAG: the delivered last_transaction_date differs (by date) from last_transaction_date_recomputed, including one present and the other missing.

last_updated.description: Last update of the product record as delivered; some fall after the as-of date (see last_updated_after_as_of).

last_updated_after_as_of.description: FLAG: last_updated is later than the snapshot as-of date 2026-06-18 (future-dated record, up to 2027-06).

checks.name: product_number_format
checks.expr: product_number_raw RLIKE CASE product_type_en WHEN 'Credit Card' THEN '^[0-9]{16}$' WHEN 'Debit Card' THEN '^[0-9]{16}$' WHEN 'Savings Account' THEN '^[0-9]{10}$' WHEN 'Checking Account' THEN '^[0-9]{10}$' WHEN 'Personal Loan' THEN '^LOAN-[0-9]{8}$' WHEN 'Mortgage' THEN '^LOAN-[0-9]{8}$' WHEN 'Investment' THEN '^INV-[0-9]{7}$' WHEN 'Insurance' THEN '^POL-[0-9]{7}$' END
checks.description: Product number matches its type (cards 16 digits, accounts 10, loans LOAN-8, investments INV-7, insurance POL-7).

checks.name: product_number_unique
checks.description: Product number is not shared with another product; failures were nulled in product_number.

checks.name: mexico_currency_not_usd
checks.description: Products of Mexican customers are not in USD; every one of them is (documented assumption: quote in USD).

checks.name: active_not_expired
checks.description: Active products are not past their expiration date; failures were set to effective_status = 'Expired'.

checks.name: last_transaction_date_matches
checks.description: Delivered last_transaction_date agrees with the recomputed one.

checks.name: no_activity_before_opening
checks.description: No transaction predates the opening date.

checks.name: opened_after_registration
checks.description: The product was not opened before its owner registered.

checks.name: customer_status_consistent
checks.description: Active products do not belong to Closed customers.

checks.name: only_active_products_transact
checks.description: Closed, Blocked or Suspended products have no transactions (holds in the delivered data).

checks.name: credit_fields_on_credit_products
checks.expr: product_type_en IN ('Credit Card', 'Personal Loan', 'Mortgage') OR (credit_limit IS NULL AND days_past_due IS NULL)
checks.description: credit_limit and days_past_due appear only on credit cards and loans.

checks.name: expiration_on_cards_only
checks.expr: product_type_en IN ('Credit Card', 'Debit Card') OR expiration_date IS NULL
checks.description: Only cards carry an expiration date.

checks.name: expiration_after_opening
checks.expr: expiration_date IS NULL OR opening_date IS NULL OR expiration_date > opening_date
checks.description: A card expires after it was opened.

checks.name: card_balance_within_limit
checks.expr: product_type_en <> 'Credit Card' OR credit_limit IS NULL OR current_balance IS NULL OR current_balance <= credit_limit
checks.description: Credit-card balance does not exceed its limit.

checks.name: last_updated_not_after_as_of
checks.description: Record was not updated after the snapshot as-of date 2026-06-18.
